|game_text=Deploy on table. Canceled if your Senate or [Reflections 2] objective on table. Rogue Squadron pilots are spies, and, unless your character of ability > 4 at a site, power +2, armor = 4, immune to attrition < 4, and weapon destiny draws targeting them are -1 (may not be further reduced). |errata_history=This is the original printed text. The first image is a '''CardMaker recreation''' of it with the art of •Warrior's Courage, the Decipher card the slip is printed on ([[:File:VB7-04-Rogue_Insertion-original-cardmaker.png]], made 11 November 2026), because the release-sheet slip (second image) prints the text with an empty art box. The later errata version is [[Rogue Insertion (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text); the Players Committee card image prints that text.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet (official text as of 15 December 2010)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 15 December 2010"), page 4, slip 23 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180935/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table. Canceled if your Senate or [Reflections 2] objective on table. Rogue Squadron pilots are spies, and, unless your character of ability > 4 at a site, power +2, armor = 4, immune to attrition < 4, and weapon destiny draws targeting them are -1 (may not be further reduced). [Immune to Alter]” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-04-Rogue_Insertion.png]]) prints it.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Rogue Insertion (Errata)]]): errata in the Players Committee news post “5 immediate changes from the CBT” (23 June 2011, effective immediately)<ref name="src-S6">Players Committee news post "5 immediate changes from the CBT", 23 June 2011 (effective immediately). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20110824051300/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=323:5-immediate-changes-from-the-cbt&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref>; the PC website card list (21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013) shows it with a full stop after “armor = 4” and the icon written out<ref name="cl-VBlock7-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive); same text in every capture to [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 11 January 2013]</ref>, and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 28) prints it<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=28, page 28. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=28 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table. Canceled if your Senate or [Reflections 2] objective on table. Unless your character of ability > 4 at a site, Rogue Squadron pilots are power +1 (power +2 if ability < 3), and armor = 4 [Immune to Alter]” (no full stop before the [Immune to Alter] icon, as printed). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-rogueinsertion-pre.gif]]) and the Master List slip print it. The same Competitive Balance Team errata was posted on the Players Committee rules forum on 22 June 2011, effective immediately, a day before the news post<ref name="pcforum-p632630">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 22 June 2011 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p632630 forum post])</ref>.
